oneLiner: Turn rough status bullets into two ready-to-send updates — one for execs, one for the team.
problem: People write status updates twice: a terse, outcome-focused version for leadership and a detailed, context-rich version for their team. Doing this manually is slow, inconsistent, and often skipped, so stakeholders get either too much noise or too little signal.
targetUser: Team leads, PMs, and ICs who send recurring status updates to both leadership and their working team.
coreFlow: Paste or type rough status bullets into a single input.
Tag each bullet as done, in progress, blocked, or FYI (optional but speeds review).
Select audience presets: Executive (outcomes, risks, asks) and Team (detail, dependencies, next steps).
Generate both drafts side by side, each editable inline.
Copy either version individually or send both via email/Slack export.

screens.name: Compose
screens.purpose: Capture rough bullets, optional tags, and context like project name and update period.

screens.name: Generate & Review
screens.purpose: Show side-by-side Exec and Team drafts with inline editing and regenerate-on-selection controls.

screens.name: Templates & Presets
screens.purpose: Define reusable audience rules, voice, length limits, and banned/required phrases.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Browse past updates, duplicate or diff against the previous period, and re-export.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage integrations, default audiences, tone, and account preferences.

outOfScope: Automatic ingestion from Jira, GitHub, or other trackers in v1
